answer: By bonding each identity to a scarce saffron-tier stake deposit, the protocol makes every pseudonym costly and forces sybils to lock real capital before voting. A decaying ember penalty burns a fraction of that stake per epoch, while a cross-shard bridge reconciles attestations so duplicate identities surface as correlated slashing events under the cooperative. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
